verdict.rationale: mise ships CI-specific docs: a mise-action to install mise/tools in pipelines, lockfiles for reproducible installs (`mise install --locked`), and version pinning guidance, which indirectly help CI speed and reproducibility. However there is no explicit documentation of a cache-restore step (e.g. caching the tool install directory across CI runs) nor any concrete mention of offline-capable installs. Missing for 10: documented cache-restore/cache-key setup for mise-action or CI, explicit offline-install mode/documentation, and independent benchmarks showing CI speedup.
